beats.narration: Mia, when I was eight I barely talked and wore sunglasses everywhere. I told Mom I wanted to be a scientist and she got excited. I battled Yugioh cards with my brother and sister.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Quiet belonging in being noticed by Mom and playing with siblings.

beats.narration: At seventeen I got my license and my car, a 2000 Honda Accord Coupe with faded paint and no air conditioning. I added an aux converter so I could play my tunes.
beats.emotionalPurpose: First freedom and pride in owning something mine.

beats.narration: I finished high school early. I finished coding bootcamp. At nineteen I got my first software engineering job. Living at home on fifty thousand dollars, I stopped worrying about money.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Relief and earned confidence after finishing early and getting hired.

beats.narration: I met my wife long distance. Every week at eight at night she appeared on FaceTime. That consistency made me fall in love. Mia, I love you, even when I do not show it.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Steady love built through showing up, passed to my daughter.
